title: Identifying Potential Inlets of Man in the Artificial Intelligence Development Process

bias_targets.methodology: Conceptual deconstruction and critical analysis of the standard AI development lifecycle (broken down into six stages) to identify systemic inlets where antiblackness is perpetuated and the 'biocentric Man' is centered as the default human.

Qualitative evaluation of AI development practices, highlighting the exploitation of underpaid workers during dataset creation and referencing how AI systems underdiagnose or harm people from lower socioeconomic statuses.

Conceptual analysis defining the foundational assumption of the 'ideal human' as a cisgender man, supported by references to existing literature on AI diagnostic tools that consistently underdiagnose women.
